field_dictionary.name: OBJECTID
field_dictionary.description: Esri-generated feature identifier; unique row identifier within this release.

field_dictionary.name: REACH_ID
field_dictionary.description: River reach identifier used to link to HydroATLAS.

field_dictionary.name: GOID
field_dictionary.description: Global object identifier used to identify a reach across free-flowing-river assessments and link dams to reaches.

field_dictionary.name: NOID
field_dictionary.description: Network object identifier; same purpose as GOID.

field_dictionary.name: NUOID
field_dictionary.description: One or more upstream NOIDs separated by underscores; an empty value identifies a headwater reach.

field_dictionary.name: NDOID
field_dictionary.description: Next downstream NOID; zero denotes a terminal reach.

field_dictionary.name: CON_ID
field_dictionary.description: Continent identifier: 1 North America, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Africa, 5 Asia, 6 Australia.

field_dictionary.name: CONTINENT
field_dictionary.description: Continent name; boundaries are delineated from HydroBASINS.

field_dictionary.name: COUNTRY
field_dictionary.description: Country name.

field_dictionary.name: BAS_ID
field_dictionary.description: HydroSHEDS hydrological river basin identifier.

field_dictionary.name: BAS_NAME
field_dictionary.description: Hydrological basin name when available.

field_dictionary.name: LENGTH_KM
field_dictionary.description: Length of the river reach.

field_dictionary.name: VOLUME_TCM
field_dictionary.description: Volume of the reach channel, calculated from width, length, and depth.

field_dictionary.name: UPLAND_SKM
field_dictionary.description: Upstream watershed area of the river reach.

field_dictionary.name: DIS_AV_CMS
field_dictionary.description: Average long-term (1971–2000) naturalized discharge.

field_dictionary.name: RIV_ORD
field_dictionary.description: River order calculated from long-term average discharge using logarithmic classes.

field_dictionary.name: ERO_YLD_TON
field_dictionary.description: Erosion yield summed within the river reach catchment; not accumulated along the network.

field_dictionary.name: HYFALL
field_dictionary.description: Presence (1) or absence (0) of one or more waterfalls along the reach.

field_dictionary.name: BB_ID
field_dictionary.description: Backbone river identifier for a contiguous source-to-terminus flow path.

field_dictionary.name: BB_NAME
field_dictionary.description: Backbone river name.

field_dictionary.name: BB_LEN_KM
field_dictionary.description: Backbone river length, the sum of its reach lengths.

field_dictionary.name: BB_DIS_ORD
field_dictionary.description: Discharge order of the most downstream reach in the backbone river.

field_dictionary.name: BB_VOL_TCM
field_dictionary.description: Backbone river volume, the sum of its reach volumes.

field_dictionary.name: BB_OCEAN
field_dictionary.description: Indicates whether the backbone river is directly connected to the ocean (1) or not (0).

field_dictionary.name: INC
field_dictionary.description: Analysis filter: Grill et al. (2019) included reaches with value 1 in analysis results.

field_dictionary.name: DOF
field_dictionary.description: Degree of fragmentation pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: DOR
field_dictionary.description: Degree of regulation pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: SED
field_dictionary.description: Sediment trapping pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: USE
field_dictionary.description: Water consumption pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: URB
field_dictionary.description: Urbanization pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: RDD
field_dictionary.description: Road construction pressure index (0–100%).

field_dictionary.name: FLD
field_dictionary.description: Inundation (floodplain) extent in the river reach catchment (%).

field_dictionary.name: CSI
field_dictionary.description: Connectivity Status Index (0–100%); 100% is full connectivity.

field_dictionary.name: CSI_D
field_dictionary.description: Dominant pressure factor; documented values include DOF, DOR, SED, USE, RDD, and URB.

field_dictionary.name: CSI_FF
field_dictionary.description: Indicates whether CSI is below (0) or above (1) the 95% free-flowing threshold.

field_dictionary.name: CSI_FF1
field_dictionary.description: Two-category free-flowing status: free-flowing (1) or non-free-flowing (3).

field_dictionary.name: CSI_FF2
field_dictionary.description: Three-category status: free-flowing (1), good connectivity (2), or impacted (3).

field_dictionary.name: CSI_FFID
field_dictionary.description: Identifier for contiguous river stretches.

field_dictionary.name: Shape_Length
field_dictionary.description: Length value maintained by the ESRI File Geodatabase; see LENGTH_KM for reach length.

field_dictionary.name: Shape
field_dictionary.description: Source MultiLineString reach geometry, stored as WKB without coordinate transformation.

source_field_metadata.ARROW:extension:name: geoarrow.wkb
